newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan money rates end higher, seen stable.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan money rates end higher, seen stable.

text.p: Taiwan's money rates closed higher on Friday as banks turned cautious on concerns of tightening liquidity, dealers said.
The overnight interbank rate finished at 4.844 against Wednesday's 4.804 end, with 30-day commercial paper up to 4.75-4.80 against 4.70-4.75. Thursday was a public holiday.
Dealers expected the interbank rate to stay around 4.90-5.00 percent next week.
The bond market was quiet in directionless trade, with many investors adopting a wait-and-see attitude ahead of the central bank's October 19 board meeting. -- Julie Hu (5080815)
